canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
The Wand-lighting Charm supports a lighting function, not automatic spell knowledge or a generic mana pool.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects, but mending a wand's exterior does not restore its damaged magic.
The dossier supplies no numerical casting cost or duration for the Mending Charm.

startAssumptions: Magically eligible adult learner owns an intact wand and has learned Lumos and Nox.
Nonmagical adult visitor owns a wand but has no magical source or learned casting ability.
Learner is in a dim storage room with freedom to leave; no enemies, quests, or rewards exist.
Reparo is a later separate learned method, not granted by this starting premise.
stateAndReaders: Reader: visibility_check consumes emitted light and normal observation conditions; magical eligibility and learned spells gate casting, not observing light.

actions.name: Cast_Lumos
actions.preconditions: Actor has magical_eligibility, wand_integrity true, learned_spells includes Lumos.
actions.effect: Wand state becomes active_light; emitted light is consumed by the normal visibility/observation reader without a new caster-eligibility restriction.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 defines effect; O1 proposes local visibility consumer; no mana/cooldown.

actions.name: Cast_Nox
actions.preconditions: Actor has magical_eligibility, wand state is active_light, learned_spells includes Nox.
actions.effect: Wand state becomes extinguished; local visibility returns to ambient.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 defines effect; O1 proposes state toggle; no numerical cost.

actions.name: Attempt_Cast
actions.preconditions: Actor lacks magical_eligibility OR wand_integrity is false OR spell not learned.
actions.effect: No mutation; action fails silently; no new mastery or items awarded.
actions.sourceVsDesign: P1 enforces refusal; O1 defines no-mutation failure; no source-specified penalty.

actions.name: Leave_Room
actions.effect: Actor exits; light state persists under save policy; no quest completion.
actions.sourceVsDesign: P1 allows free leaving; O1 mandates persistence; no reward.

missingConsumers: Magical integrity vs physical mending distinction
No-mutation failure handler for ineligible actors

counterexamples: Nonmagical visitor attempts Lumos: fails due to no magical source, despite wand ownership.
Learner attempts Reparo on broken wand: fails as Reparo is not yet learned in this slice.
Mending wand exterior with Reparo: does not restore magic, per H2.
Casting Lumos without learned spell: fails; no automatic knowledge granted.
futureWitness: Lumos/Nox toggle works only for eligible learner with intact wand and learned spells.
Nonmagical visitor attempts fail with no mutation, no items, no mastery.
Leaving room persists light state under approved save policy; no quest completion.
Reparo limit: mends exterior only; does not restore magic or grant new spells.
No source-specified mana, cooldowns, or mandatory quests are enforced.
Adapter must implement eligibility, spell sets, and scoped light; current adapter lacks these.
numericalPolicy: No source-specified mana, cooldowns, or numerical costs. Design proposals may add values but must be labeled as proposals, not canon.
